normal_priority_diagnostic.interpretation: the resident polling workgroup prevents the ring queue from making forward progress; after the bounded poll releases, the ring runs and the final values happen to become exact

low_priority_diagnostic.result: no forward progress for more than 30 seconds after communicator initialization; probe terminated
low_priority_diagnostic.interpretation: a low-priority resident queue does not permit safe ring preemption and instead starves the joined dependency

decision: closed before the 6 us per-boundary performance gate and before full-model integration; finite two-stream overlap does not imply forward progress for a persistent polling kernel on the current Xe/Level Zero runtime
